summary: The CASE-03 routing regression test fails only inside the formal runner because its simulated child smoke process inherits the real outer assertion-protocol owner identity.
root_cause: The routing-test harness copies SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_PROTOCOL_OWNER_PID and SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_PROTOCOL_EMITTED from process.env. Its simulated run-smoke child then correctly declines ownership of the temporary assertion result file, while the isolated test expects that child to become the owner.
